title: Naturality of pulled-back generator sections
statement: For schemes X,Y [def-pc-scheme], f:Y→X and an invertible X-module L [def-sc-invertible-module] with invertible tensor pullback f*L [def-pc-module-pullback], let T_L,T_f*L be their étale generator torsors [def-sc-gm-torsor]. Write b(W)=W×_X Y and P_W:T_L(W)→T_f*L(b(W)) for the explicit section construction [lem-sc-etale-generators-pullback-section]. For every étale arrow i:V→W and generator s in T_L(W), restriction of P_W(s) along b(i) equals P_V of the restriction of s along i. This is a restriction identity for the already constructed map, with no existence or equivariance claim.

source.place: Lemma 21.6.1, generator torsor construction; pullback/restriction of its trivializations.

proof.text: Unfold both torsor restrictions as pullHom and expand each section as A_U.hom followed by p_U* of the trivialization followed by B_U(L).hom. Express pullHom with pullbackCompOfEq. Use the source and target comparison identities; the middle square is naturality of the canonical natural isomorphism between j*p_W* and p_V*i*. Insert K and its inverse, cancel the isomorphisms, and use associativity. Finish by subtype and ULift extensionality.

based_on.place: Lemma 21.6.1, generator torsor construction; pullback/restriction of its trivializations.

lean.statement: theorem etaleGeneratorsPullbackSection_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (L : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u} L] [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u} ((tensorPullback f).obj L)] {V W : X.Etale} (i : V ⟶ W) (s : (etaleIsoTorsor L).sheaf.obj.obj (op W)) : (etaleIsoTorsor ((tensorPullback f).obj L)).sheaf.obj.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).map i).op (etaleGeneratorsPullbackSection f L W s) = etaleGeneratorsPullbackSection f L V ((etaleIsoTorsor L).sheaf.obj.map i.op s)
